name: USDA crop-subtype yield atlas v1 validation

gate.rule: Select neighborhood size, distance power, and history-reliability power on 2018-2020 only. Promote a crop-specific temporal blend only after at least +0.005 development Spearman with lower MAE and no rank or MAE regression in 2021-2022 stability. Select neighbor-disagreement scaling only when it reduces development mean 90% width by at least 1%; stability still sets coverage scales. Leave-one-county-out transfer within 100 km then needs final N >=100, Spearman >=0.50 with grouped-bootstrap lower >0.30; paired-bootstrap rank-gain lower >0; positive rank gain and MAE reduction over one nearest county in development, stability, and locked final blocks; no rank or MAE regression versus the best development-selected distance-only candidate in any block. Regional interval multipliers selected on development/stability must reach 80%/90%; locked pooled coverage must be 75-90%/87-96%, and every region needs final N >=50, 80% coverage >=70%, 90% coverage 85-98%, and mean 90% width <=0.90.

interpretation: Nearby-county subtype ordering and uncertainty only; not parcel yield, revenue, or purchase returns.
